Remains active while the corresponding button is held down and stops immediately when it is released. Independently configurable CPS (clicks per second) for the left and right buttons. The program should terminate when the alt key is pressed. So, first I programmed a program that can detect whether the buttons are active or not. When I pressed the mouse button, the autoclicker activated but then immediately deactivated again, even though I was still physically holding the button. After time, i realised, that the reason is that the autoclicker sends its own simulated mouse DOWN/UP events to the operating system. These simulated events override the state of the physically pressed mouse button, because the OS always trusts the most recent event. My question now is: how can I make this work according to my requirements?
